newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids higher.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were sharply higher on Monday as cash markets followed futures higher, dealers said.
"We're following the board," said one dealer.
Spring wheat futures on the Minneapolis Grain Exchange ended seven to eleven cents per bushel higher on spillover from CBOT wheat, with new crop September up 10 cents at $3.66-3/4.
Despite the market's higher prices, dealers reported very little farmer selling or movement.
"We've got grain offered out in the market but there's nobody out there to take it," a Montana dealer said.
White wheat harvest has begun in some parts of the Pacific Northwest, and dealers said early test weights were good but the wheat still had a high moisture content.
"The weather has been really humid so it's not drying down too good," said an Oregon wheat dealer.
